text.en: Reviewers praise groomer Melodi and her team for treating each visiting pet like family. Dog owners emphasize that staff members communicate honestly about pet comfort before beginning any bath or trim. Clients appreciate the calm demeanor and personal dedication shown during every visit.

title.en: Low stress handling for sensitive dogs

text.en: Pet parents highlight the salon gentle approach toward nervous, timid, and senior dogs with mobility issues. Multiple reviewers explain that the team works patiently to earn trust before starting services, ensuring animals never feel rushed or frightened during grooming or boarding.

Clients consistently report that their dogs return home looking tidy, happy, and well groomed after appointments. Owners of large breeds such as golden retrievers note that full haircuts and baths are finished smoothly without causing stiffness or distress to the animal.

q.en: Is the salon suitable for elderly dogs with joint stiffness?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that the groomer accommodates senior dogs with mobility issues through patient, gentle handling.

q.en: How do groomers handle anxious or fearful pets?

a.en: Owners report that staff prioritizes pet calm first, assessing anxiety levels before starting any bathing or clipping.

q.en: Do boarding guests receive updates during their stay?

a.en: Clients mention that the team sends responsive communication and daily video clips while pets are boarding.
